# SpellRules options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

16 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `SpellRules`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CreatureSpellCrit` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether creatures that are not player-owned may crit with spells. Retail: false (vmangos Unit::GetSpellCritChance, Unit.cpp:5216-5219 "Mobs cannot land critical strikes with spells"). |
| `DiminishingResetMs` | `uint` | `15000` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Milliseconds after the last aura of a diminishing group ended before the level resets. Retail: 15 seconds, patch 1.4.0 (2005-04-19): "Spells must be used on the same target within 15 seconds of the *end* of the duration in order to be diminished" (https://vanilla-wow-archive.fandom.com/wiki/Patch_1.4.0, PvP section); vmangos Unit::GetDiminishing, Unit.cpp:7630, agrees. |
| `DiminishingResetSweepMs` | `uint` | `0` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Period in milliseconds of a reset sweep for diminishing returns. Retail: 0, the level resets as soon as `DiminishingResetMs` has passed (patch 1.4.0). A positive value (for example 5000) reproduces the "resets between 15 and 20 seconds" reading reported for Classic Era (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Diminishing_returns, Classic section, and https://vanilla-wow-archive.fandom.com/wiki/Diminishing_returns: "it checks every 5 seconds"); neither page cites a Blizzard source. |
| `DiminishingReturns` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Whether crowd-control spells diminish (vmangos Spell.cpp:1733-1800). Retail: true; false is a dev-host switch. |
| `FrostShockDiminishesAsRoot` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether Frost Shock shares the controlled-root diminishing group with Frost Nova and Entangling Roots. Retail: false, its own "slowing effect" group (patch 1.4.0, Shaman: "This is considered a slowing effect", against "an immobilizing effect" for the roots; https://vanilla-wow-archive.fandom.com/wiki/Patch_1.4.0). true reproduces vmangos (SpellEntry.cpp:333-343, DIMINISHING_CONTROL_ROOT). |
| `IgnoreHolyResistance` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether holy resistance is ignored when resisting damage. Retail (vmangos Unit::CalculateDamageAbsorbAndResist, Unit.cpp:1936-1946): false; vmangos holds the holy resistance field at 0 (Player::UpdateResistances), so holy is only resisted through the level-based innate resist of higher-level creatures. true reproduces cmangos-classic (Unit::CalculateEffectiveMagicResistancePercent, Unit.cpp:3917: "completely ignore holy resistance value") and also drops that innate part. |
| `ImmunityEnforcement` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Whether immunities (aura-granted and creature static masks) are enforced. Retail: true; false disables every immunity check for development hosts. |
| `MagicHitFloorPercent` | `float` | `22` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Lowest base magic hit chance in percent before modifiers: 22 (vmangos SpellCaster.cpp:829-834, from a classic duel test). Set 1 to reproduce cmangos-classic, which floors the final chance only. |
| `MagnetRequiresAttackable` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether a spell redirected by a Grounding-style magnet (SPELL_MAGNET) skips a magnet the caster may not attack (an unflagged or friendly owner's totem). Default false: vmangos SpellCaster::SelectMagnetTarget (SpellCaster.cpp:31-68) has no hostility test on the magnet and mangoszero (Unit.cpp:3590 via CheckTarget) refuses only unattackable-flagged targets, with no reaction test. true reproduces mangos-classic Unit::SelectMagnetTarget (Unit.cpp:6924, CanAttack(magnet)). Reference-core evidence only, no retail capture. Applies to non-triggered casts and client-named triggered blocks, creature casters included. |
| `ResistTablePath` | `string` | `null` | text | World | start | Path of a file with vmangos' partial-resist outcome table (`ResistOutcomeTable`: 31 rows of `resist100,resist75,resist50,resist25,resist0,chanceResist`, Unit.cpp:1885-1918), which the repository does not ship. Unset: the engine draws the two quarter steps around the average resist (mean-preserving approximation, docs/areas/spell-rules.md); the damage-over-time one-tenth rule and the vulnerability bonus apply either way. |
| `SoulShardUntappedCountsAsTapped` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether a creature nobody tapped (no damage ever called LootService.OnCreatureDamaged: a scripted or GM kill) counts as tapped by the warlock for Soul Shards. Retail (vmangos Aura::HandleChannelDeathItem, SpellAuras.cpp:2860-2861, Creature::IsTappedBy, Creature.cpp:1615-1632): false, an untapped creature gives no shard. true keeps the shard for such kills. |
| `SpellBatchAuraExpiry` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | With `SpellBatchWindowMs` set: a timed aura that runs out stays until the first update of the next batch (channel auras excepted). |
| `SpellBatchCreatures` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | With `SpellBatchWindowMs` set: creature (pet, totem) casts are batched like players' (retail: every unit's messages went through the same tick). |
| `SpellBatchMelee` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | With `SpellBatchWindowMs` set: white melee swings are held and resolve at the same window boundaries (MapCombat.SwingBatch.cs). |
| `SpellBatchWindowMs` | `uint` | `0` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Spell batch window in ms (SpellSystem.Batching.cs): a player's cast that goes off is held until the window closes and then resolves with every other cast of that window, so two players who kill, charge or interrupt each other in one window both get their action. Retail 1.12 batched (Kaivax, Blizzard, 2019, https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/137118/1) and Blizzard's Classic servers used 400 ms until 1.13.7 (https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/838945). Opt-in while it is verified against a client: 0 (default) resolves every cast at once; 400 is the retail value. |
| `WorldBossLevelDiff` | `int` | `3` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Levels a world boss counts above its target (vmangos CONFIG WorldBossLevelDiff, World.cpp:744 default 3). |
